summary: Fleet Telemetry API v2 moves GET /v1/fleet/telemetry and GET /v1/robots/{robot_id}/telemetry/latest to /v2/... and bumps FleetSnapshot.api_version from v1 to v2. Orientation breaks from Euler degrees orientation.roll/pitch/yaw (intrinsic Z-Y-X) to required unit quaternion orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw} (Hamilton, scalar last). Uncertainty breaks from scalar noise (isotropic 1-sigma, metres) to required 6x6 covariance, and adds required health (0..1, alert below 0.5). Migration builds rotations directly from quaternion (yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²))) and weights by inverse position covariance (scalar sigma = sqrt(trace(P_pos)/3)).

endpoints_renamed.notes: All endpoints move from /v1/... to /v2/...; v1 endpoints are deprecated and will be shut off on 2026-12-01.

fields_removed.notes: Removed noise (isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty, metres). Replaced by covariance. Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3).

Removed orientation.pitch (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X). Replaced by orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}: a unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

Removed orientation.roll (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X). Replaced by orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}: a unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

Removed orientation.yaw (degrees, intrinsic Z-Y-X). Replaced by orientation.{qx,qy,qz,qw}: a unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly. If you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.

fields_added.notes: Added covariance: 6×6 symmetric pose covariance as nested row-major arrays. Variable order x, y, z (m) then rotation about X, Y, Z (rad). The position block covariance[0:3][0:3] is in m². Migration: anything that weighted by 1 / noise² should weight by the inverse of the position covariance block. A scalar equivalent of the old noise is sqrt(trace(P_pos) / 3).

Added required health (0..1): composite localisation/drive health from the on-robot monitor. 1 = nominal; values below 0.5 mean the robot should be serviced. Ops dashboards should raise a health alert below 0.5.

Added orientation.qw as part of unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

Added orientation.qx as part of unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

Added orientation.qy as part of unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

Added orientation.qz as part of unit quaternion, Hamilton convention, scalar last, describing the same body-to-map rotation R = Rz(yaw)·Ry(pitch)·Rx(roll) that v1 encoded. The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative.

The server does not canonicalise sign: q and -q are the same rotation and qw may be negative. Migration: build rotations from the quaternion directly. If you still need heading, use yaw = atan2(2(qw·qz + qx·qy), 1 − 2(qy² + qz²)); do not round-trip through Euler for tilt.
